Leaflet 1.9.4, from the npm package `leaflet@1.9.4`, BSD-2-Clause (LICENSE).

Vendored rather than loaded from a CDN, on purpose. The rest of this page asks
nothing of the network and works in a building with no route to the internet;
pulling the map library from cdnjs would have quietly ended that. Tiles still
need somewhere to come from, but that somewhere can be an internal tile server -
the URL is a setting on the page.
